text.what: The body at the Santa Maria Valley Chamber of Commerce that defines the local barbecue and certifies places serving it: beef rolled in salt, pepper and garlic, cooked on skewers over coals of red oak native to the valley.
text.today: Its page points readers to 'Santa Maria Style Barbeque Certified' locations and invites places to get certified; the criteria themselves were not published on the page this project read on 16 September 2026.

kin.as: The long version, with the competing claims.
The valley whose name is on the menu.
